probe.input: flattened frozen expert reads, no current bit, query address or oracle metadata
probe.label: past bit, supervision only

verifier.calibration_objective: minimize 5*false_accept_rate + false_reject_rate; tie selects highest threshold
verifier.label: positive evidence is valid in this synthetic reliability task

rules: Parent model weights and training/results are immutable; only a separate diagnostic readout probe is trained.
Freeze this design in git before measuring any new diagnostic outcomes; it is not scientific preregistration.
Oracle target-only/target-last/exact-address interventions are evaluator diagnostics and never runtime capability claims.
Evaluation labels, target slots and payloads never enter nonoracle inference; the source bit is a probe training label only.
Calibration never uses diagnostic evaluation cases or outcomes.
No model or arm is selected from evaluation performance; preserve every seed, condition and negative result.
The same development generator family remains in use; no untouched confirmatory holdout or general memory claim.
Reload checkpoints and replay raw diagnostic rows; retain probe weights, fingerprints, gradients, all predictions and source hashes.
State equality implies no deterministic decoder can distinguish that counterfactual pair; unequal state alone does not establish readable information.
Swap accuracy is algebraically complementary on opposite-label matched pairs and is not independent statistical evidence.
No SOTA, sublinear total work, faithful modern-baseline reproduction or general verifier result.
